verdict.rationale: USCIS documents paper filing by mail, which requires completing forms such as G-1450 and G-1650. The evidence pack also states that the G-28 paperwork is published on the site. Together these imply forms are publicly obtainable, though no item explicitly says forms and instructions can be downloaded without an account. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that form PDFs and instructions are freely downloadable without login, evidence covering instructions documents specifically, and hands-on or independent confirmation of account-free download.
